_readme: Benchmarks for the Benchmark page. Edit freely; no code changes needed. The order here is the order in the picker.
tickers: Yahoo Finance symbols, tried in order until one returns history. Prices are converted to EUR with daily FX.
Prefer accumulating UCITS ETFs: their price includes reinvested dividends (total return), which is the fair comparison for your portfolio, whose dividends are counted too.
Symbols starting with '^' are price indices (no dividends) and only used as a fallback. Futures (=F) and crypto have no dividends anyway.
group: used to group the picker. default: selected when the page opens.

FTSE All-World.note: Vanguard FTSE All-World (Acc), incl. emerging markets

Brent crude.note: Front-month futures, in EUR (no roll costs)

Euro govt bonds.note: iShares Core € Govt Bond, dividends reinvested

Euro cash (€STR).note: Xtrackers € Overnight Rate: what a savings-like cash position earned
